messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU allocation failures detected in eu-west-2 (ukwest). Autoscaler is receiving quota DENY errors and is not progressing. Queue length for inference requests > 3k and climbing. Observed customer error rate ~45%. Paging @luke_oncall and ops.
luke_oncall: on it. quick status? can someone paste the failing autoscaler logs and quota error text?
maya: pasting from autoscaler logs: ``ERROR: allocation failed: quotaExceeded for resource 'acceleratorCount' in project redwood-prod. region=eu-west-2, requested=40, available=0``
sam_ops: opening cloud support case now. Case created: GCP-INC-2024-82931, submitted escalation to account team. link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/GCP-INC-2024-82931
evans_sre: tagging in routing: we can gate new traffic to ukwest and divert to us-west1 for high-latency sensitive customers. will that help reduce error rate quickly?
ashley_support: customer 3 oncall reported degraded service for a few tenants (three paying customers flagged). they're seeing request timeouts and retries. We're getting tickets. Need ETA.
luke_oncall: prioritise mitigation: 1) divert traffic 2) free capacity by draining/evicting noncritical pools 3) fallback to smaller model if needed. who's owning each?
maya: I can run the quota check across other eu regions to confirm spare capacity. running:

```
# check regional accelerator quotas
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west2 --project=redwood-prod --format='json(quota)' | jq '.quota[] | select(.metric=="ACCELERATOR_" or .metric=="ACCELERATOR_QUOTA")'
```

Output snippet: ``"metric": "ACCELERATOR_TOTAL_GPUS", "limit": 0, "usage": 120`` -> looks like account hardcap in eu-west-2 is 0 available.
gcp-cloud-bot: Auto-update: support case GCP-INC-2024-82931 has been escalated to SE. Estimated initial response 20-40m. Link updated on ticket.
sam_ops: meanwhile I requested temporary quota increase via account team (internal contact: @gcp-sales). sent docs for justification + timeframe (expect 1-2h if approved fast).
evans_sre: I'll start rerouting high-priority customers to us-west1 via traffic policy. quick config change:

```
# pseudo-rule
routes.add({ region: 'eu-west-2', fallback: ['us-west1'], priority: 50, match: { customers: ['enterprise-tier'] }})
```

luke_oncall: do it. also free up capacity: pause background batch jobs in eu-west-2, scale down warm pools for non-prod.
maya: running drain command for non-prod pools:

```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool nonprod-eu-west-2 --desired 0 --grace 60s
```

Logs: "decommissioning 6 nodes from nonprod-eu-west-2 -> freed 12 GPUs"

ashley_support: customers updated: told them we're rerouting traffic and working with cloud to restore capacity. one asked for ETA on per-tenant SLA impact.
luke_oncall: quick health check: queue length dropping? cloud autoscaler events?
maya: queue dropped from 3200 -> 1400 after reroute + drain. autoscaler still logging quota errors when trying to provision more in eu-west-2. Trying to provision 8 GPUs returns quotaExceeded.
sam_ops: cloud support SE just replied: "account-wide quota configured low for this project; manual uplift required by Google team. we can request emergency uplift but need billing/POC confirmation." They asked for severity justification.
evans_sre: temp mitigation: enable regional fallback pool using us-west1 and ap-south1 as secondary. also enable smaller quantized model for lower-priority traffic:

```
# runtime change
route.apply({ fallback_model: 'rwd-4b-quant', routes: ['non-enterprise'] })
```

luke_oncall: do it. annotate everything. we must avoid noisy restarts.
maya: applied fallback model for non-enterprise, confirmed lower token latency but higher variance. noncritical error surface reduced.
incident-bot: Incident status: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING. page count: 4. active oncall: luke_oncall. slack-bridge: #inc-1756789012
sam_ops: quick note: requested emergency quota lift with subject "Emergency: EU-WEST-2 GPU capacity for production". included customer-impact screenshots and queue metrics. awaiting approval.
ashley_support: updating customers: some enterprise tenants still on eu-west-2 and experiencing ~10% error rate until reroute completes. others fully rerouted.
evans_sre: running a short-lived scaling test to verify fallback works end-to-end. command:

```
redwoodctl test-scale --region us-west1 --model rwd-4b-quant --concurrency 200
```

Test passed, serving capacity available in us-west1. Starting gradual traffic migration.
luke_oncall: good. please keep me posted on cloud ticket and if they will approve a rapid uplift. also log any account policy blockers.
sam_ops: SE replied: "We can provision temporary GPU quota in 2-4 hours with account team approval, or provide quota in alternative regions immediately. No immediate uplift in europe unless legal/billing sign-off." — not ideal.
maya: since EU uplift will take too long, recommend continuing reroute + enable autoscaler to prefer cross-region placements. I've opened an internal deploy to flip preferCrossRegion: true for autoscaler.
evans_sre: applied preferCrossRegion: true. autoscaler can now provision in us-west1 for eu traffic where latency tolerance allows. Queue fell to ~200 and error rate back to <2%.
incident-bot: Update: MITIGATED -> ALL CLEAR. Root cause: account-level accelerator quota in eu-west-2 (hardcap) + autoscaler policy that disallowed cross-region provisioning. Mitigations: traffic reroute, non-prod drain, fallback model, preferCrossRegion toggle. Cloud ticket remains open for permanent quota increase.
ashley_support: closing customer tickets with note and ETA for permanent fix once quota uplift confirmed. customers asked for postmortem.
luke_oncall: assigning postmortem owners: maya (root cause & autoscaler policy), evan_sre (mitigations & runbook updates). sam_ops to own cloud account coordination. due EOD tomorrow.
maya: quick follow-ups: 1) add alert for regional accelerator availability = 0 2) make preferCrossRegion default for burst capacity 3) update runbook to include immediate reroute steps and who to call at GCP sales.
evans_sre: will prepare a short runbook patch and a dashboard showing per-region accelerator usage + pending autoscaler requests.
incident-bot: Incident closed. duration ~31m. Tags: quota, autoscaler, cross-region, customer-impact. Postmortem channel: #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
